WITH wks AS (
  SELECT WK_END_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC) rn
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY)
),
rx AS (
  SELECT p.TERR_ID, w.rn, r.TRX_QTY, r.NRX_QTY
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r
  JOIN wks w ON r.WK_END_DT = w.WK_END_DT AND w.rn <= 26
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON r.PRSCRBR_ME = p.PRSCRBR_ME
  WHERE r.PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110')
)
SELECT t.DISTRICT_ID, t.TERR_ID, t.TERR_NM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=13 THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) trx_l13,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn>13 THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) trx_p13,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=13 THEN NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) nrx_l13,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rn>13 THEN NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END) nrx_p13,
  ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=13 THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rn>13 THEN TRX_QTY ELSE 0 END),0)-1),1) trx_chg_pct,
  ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=13 THEN NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rn>13 THEN NRX_QTY ELSE 0 END),0)-1),1) nrx_chg_pct,
  (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT) FROM wks WHERE rn<=13) first_wk, (SELECT MAX(WK_END_DT) FROM wks) last_wk
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t LEFT JOIN rx ON rx.TERR_ID = t.TERR_ID
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
